What it costs: $0 — TV news widget is free for everyone.
What you get: 1000+ source aggregator · ticker-mapped · sentiment-tagged · auto-refresh · clickable cards.
Where it lives: Home tab (replaces or supplements current qc-news renderer) + Detail tab News sub-panel filtered to ticker.
▦ PER-TICKER NEWS
In Detail tab → News sub-panel
The widget supports per-symbol filter via symbol="NASDAQ:NVDA" param. So when user opens NVDA detail, the embed instance only shows NVDA-tagged headlines. 
// Renders into Detail tab → News sub-panel
<div class="tradingview-widget-container">
  <script async
    src="https://s3.tradingview.com/external-embedding/embed-widget-timeline.js">
  {
    "feedMode": "symbol",
    "symbol":   "NASDAQ:NVDA",
    "colorTheme": "dark",
    "isTransparent": true,
    "displayMode": "regular",
    "width":  "100%",
    "height": 540,
    "locale": "en"
  }
  </script>
</div>
▦ INTEGRATION PLAN
1 Add TV news widget to Home → replaces existing qc-news card
2 Add per-ticker variant to Detail → News sub-panel
3 Keep our EODHD news as fallback if TV widget fails to load (offline / blocked)
4 Maintain our position+watchlist filter on top of TV feed (post-process via TV's feedMode:"market" + ticker-list filter)
5 Surface TV-source dedup (TV often republishes same Reuters wire → flag duplicates)

▦ TRADE-OFFS
VS LIGHTWEIGHT CHARTSResult
Chart UX qualityTV wins
Indicators availableTV wins (100+)
Drawing toolsTV wins
Data control (our overlay)LWC wins
Custom annotations (VCP zones, S/R)LWC wins
Bundle sizeLWC wins (40KB vs ~1MB iframe)
Offline / EODHD failure modeLWC wins
Hybrid recommendation: Keep Lightweight Charts as the default (custom annotations, our VCP zones, EODHD data). Add a "Open in TradingView" button per chart that pops up a TV embed in a modal — get the best of both.
C · TRADINGVIEW ALERTS → /api/tv-alert WEBHOOK live signals push into kairos · the only "real-time data" path
▦ FLOW
1 You configure TV alerts (100/Pro) — e.g. "NVDA crosses above 50EMA", "SPY RSI < 30", "BTC volume +200%"
2 TV fires alert → POSTs JSON to your webhook URL (Pro feature, not Free)
3 Our new endpoint /api/tv-alert receives, validates HMAC, parses, stores
4 Alert lands in the Home Smart Alerts strip live (via SSE or polling)
5 Optionally: alert triggers an auto-pin in Audit Trail, or fires a Slack ping 
# In server.py
@app.post("/api/tv-alert")
async def tv_alert(req: Request):
    body = await req.json()
    # TV sends fields you define in alert message JSON
    # {ticker, condition, price, time, exchange, ...}
    _persist_tv_alert(body)
    _push_to_smart_alerts(body)
    return {"status": "received"}

MY THOUGHTS · WHAT TO SHIP IN WHAT ORDER

Phase 1 — News widget (1 hour, ship today). The TV News timeline widget is the highest-leverage addition. It's free, broader than EODHD news, sentiment-tagged, ticker-linked, and the embed is one script tag. Drop it on Home (replaces the current News card) and on Detail → News sub-panel (per-ticker). Keep our EODHD news as fallback for when the iframe blocks.

Phase 2 — TV Alerts webhook (3 hours, ship this week). Build /api/tv-alert endpoint. Add UI in Settings to show your webhook URL + HMAC secret. Alerts land in Smart Alerts strip on Home. Your TV Pro account = 100 alerts. Intraday signal coverage we currently lack.

Phase 3 — Selective widget embeds (1 day, optional). Add TV Economic Calendar (replaces our hardcoded macro events). Add TV Heatmap to Market Map tab as alt-view toggle. Add Advanced Chart embed as Open in TradingView modal button per existing Lightweight Chart.

What I would NOT do: Replace Lightweight Charts wholesale with TV embed. Our chart annotations (VCP zones, EMA stack, S/R levels, structural targets) are kairos's edge. TV embed is generic. Keep both — LWC default, TV as supplementary deep-dive modal.

What I would NEVER do: Reverse-engineer TV's internal WebSocket (option D in the prior question). Ban risk + may break anytime + violates ToS. The webhook path (Option C) gets you 95% of what scraping would give, legitimately.
